reason: The README clearly describes a document-processing plugin for reading, creating, editing, auditing, merging, and splitting common office file formats through dsh tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供电子表格、PDF、演示文稿和 Word 文档的读取、创建、编辑及处理工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness tools to read, create, edit, audit, merge, and split spreadsheets, PDFs, presentations, and Word documents.

capabilities: Read text and structure from XLSX, PDF, PPTX, and DOCX files
Create and edit local spreadsheets, PDFs, presentations, and Word documents
Recalculate and statically audit spreadsheet formulas
